Our mission is to improve Quality-of-Life for all beings by Visioneering bold ideas into real-world progress. Our Capabilities As Science, Technology and Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) , we are involved in a plethora of Life Science, Materials Science, and AgriTech/Food Science initiatives. These initiatives include both deep science and technology strategy consulting and industry marketing services and analysis. Scientific Data & Process Strategy We work with you to develop a value-driven R&D strategy, supporting an "In-Silico first" approach where applicable. We help you achieve FAIR compliance and create an efficient SMART, digital lab environment. Next-Generation Laboratories We promote the Cloud Lab concept and help companies use and build Cloud Labs. We’ll get you up to speed quickly, maximizing ROI and speeding up experimental results. AI & GenAI Strategy Since 1998, 20/15 Visioneers have led In-Silico NME discovery using machine learning and predictive science. With expertise in commercial, bespoke, and open-source tools, we help you discover more in various therapeutic areas at lower costs. R&D IT/IX Strategy Roadmaps We work with you and your team to develop a sustainable tool and solution approach that ultimately reduces point solutions and supports FAIR data-driven environments. Go-to-Market Strategy We work closely with startups and established companies to perfect their Go-to-Market strategies with highly technical services, advanced products, and scientific software. Analysis & Vendor Selection We have a spotless track record for helping all types of clients select the best software for their current and future needs. Key Partnerships We work with biopharma, biotech, CPG, energy, technology organizations, and the world's leading Scientific Software companies! We choose not to reveal our 200+ customers on our website out of privacy but we are more than happy to provide references on request.
